Context: 4. Contributory Provident Fund

## 4. Contributory Provident Fund  
[ Applicable to those Central Government employees who have been appointed on or before 31-12-2003 ]  
The rules for GPF and CPF are the same, except for the following differences:-  
1. Emoluments.employees not remunerated by fixed monthly pay.
2. Includes also any wages paid by Government to - Rule 2 (1) (ii) (b).
2. Admission to the Fund.servant is to compulsorily subscribe to the Fund.
4. Every non-pensionable Government - Rule 4.
